title: 第一卷 第23章 圆满箭术第一卷 第24章 山林反杀
content_zh:
“这些混混都是狗皮膏药一样的角色，不把他们镇住，不会那么老实。”
回到院子里，李乘风想到刚才瘦混混那一句，100文钱是够了的话头，摇了摇头，眼里闪过一抹冷意。
但想到这些帮派的事不是他现在能管得，只得暂且压下，默默的在竹林遮挡下，继续练武。
一直到那混混的喧嚣声走远了，他才打开门，让刘玉娘从屋里出来。
见外面没事，刘玉娘心里松了口气，随后到院子门口左右看了看，回来跟李乘风说，王婶和陈婶一个比一个愁眉苦脸，唉声叹气。
“有这黑河帮在，咱们的苦日子什么时候才能是个头啊？”
刘玉娘忍不住发出一声叹息。
李乘风知道如果不是黑河帮的威胁在，原生或许也不会动着卖嫂子的心思。
想到这些为害乡里的黑帮，他默默地继续练拳。
【太极拳熟练度+1】
..................
..................
..................
黑河帮搜完保家钱后，时间飞逝，一转眼。
又一个月时间过去。
自从找了一次刘勇，把他要卖嫂子的事情揭过之后，李乘风每天都在家中习武练箭，从早到晚，从不停歇。
偶有刮风下雨，也在家里练，一日不曾间断功法的修炼和箭术的修行。
而一个月的时间过去，捕来的野猪肉也在李乘风的大胃口之中，渐渐的被吃光了。
这一日，收保家钱的时间又到了。
李乘风又交了100文的保家钱，那胖混混见着更强壮的李乘风，清点铜钱的过程变得规矩了一些，只是依然面无表情。

一直到他们离开，李乘风才回去继续练武。
如此，转眼到了傍晚。
“嗖～”
李乘风拉开层压竹弓，瞄准前方的靶子，手中一松，箭术瞬间飞出。
“哗~”
在命中靶心的一刹那，又一股感悟从他心中猛然浮现。
这种感悟之下，瞬间让他对箭术的种种方法、技巧，都有了更深的理解。
更有一股全新的感悟出现，让他理解该如何射箭才能增加箭矢的穿透力。
等到这股感悟消化完毕，李乘风目光不自觉看向自己的技能面板。
【技能：箭术】
【等级：圆满（15000）】
【效果：稳定增加60%；准度增加50%；箭速增加20%；省力增加10%；穿透增加5%】
“箭术圆满了。”
看着果然随着这一箭突破的箭术等级，李乘风眼里露出一抹神采。
他又低头看了看手中已经松松垮垮的层压足弓，摇了摇头，将其弓弦取下，把它放在了房屋一角。
这把层压竹弓，也是功臣了，他打算好好保存。
放好层压竹弓，又抬头看了一眼只剩下最后两块腊肉的房间，李乘风心中明白，到了去山里狩猎的时候了。
他低头看了看自己越发精壮的身体，双拳一握，感受着双臂中传来的力量感，眼里闪过一抹神采。
又看了看太极拳的进度。
【技能：太极拳】

【等级：入门（676800）】
【效果：整劲】
“虽然没有突破，但是这一个月600余点熟练度下来，在技能的效果下，我的身体也淬炼得远比一个月前要强许多。”
李乘风摸了摸自己结实许多的肌肉和强了许多的力量，对这一个月的收获感到满意。
但随后又想到了刘勇，眼里闪过一抹冷芒，“和你的事也该解决了。”
content_en:
"These gangsters are like dog-skin plasters. If we don't control them, they won't be so honest."
Back in the yard, Li Chengfeng thought of what the skinny gangster had said earlier, that 100 pennies was enough, and shook his head, with a cold look in his eyes.
But thinking that the affairs of these gangs were beyond his control now, he had to suppress it for the time being and continue practicing martial arts silently under the cover of the bamboo forest.
It wasn't until the noise of the gangster had gone away that he opened the door and let Liu Yuniang come out of the house.
Seeing that nothing was going on outside, Liu Yuniang breathed a sigh of relief. She then went to the door of the courtyard and looked around. When she came back, she told Li Chengfeng that Aunt Wang and Aunt Chen were looking more worried and sighing.
"With the Heihe Gang here, when will our hard life end?"
Liu Yuniang couldn't help but sigh.
Li Chengfeng knew that if it weren't for the threat from the Heihe Gang, Yuan Yuan might not be tempted to sell his sister-in-law.
Thinking of these gangsters who were harming the village, he continued to practice boxing silently.
[Tai Chi proficiency +1]
.....................
.....................
.....................
After the Heihe Gang searched for the money to protect the family, time flew by in a blink of an eye.
Another month has passed.
Ever since he found Liu Yong and revealed that he wanted to sell his sister-in-law, Li Chengfeng practiced martial arts and archery at home every day, from morning to night, never stopping.
Occasionally it was windy or rainy, so I would practice at home. I never stopped practicing the exercises and archery throughout the day.
And a month passed, and the wild boar meat that was caught was gradually eaten up by Li Chengfeng's huge appetite.
On this day, it was time to collect money from the guarantee family again.
Li Chengfeng handed over another 100 coins to protect his family. Seeing the stronger Li Chengfeng, the fat gangster became more disciplined in the process of counting the coins, but his face remained expressionless.
It wasn't until they left that Li Chengfeng went back to continue practicing martial arts.
So, it was evening in a blink of an eye.
"Whoosh~"
Li Chengfeng opened the laminated bamboo bow and aimed at the target in front of him. As soon as his hand was released, the arrow flew out instantly.
"Wow~"
The moment he hit the target, another realization suddenly emerged from his heart.
This realization instantly gave him a deeper understanding of the various methods and techniques of archery.
A new insight emerged, allowing him to understand how to shoot arrows to increase the penetrating power of arrows.
After this realization was digested, Li Chengfeng looked at his skill panel unconsciously.
[Skill: Archery]
[Level: Perfect (15000)]
[Effect: stability increased by 60%; accuracy increased by 50%; arrow speed increased by 20%; labor saving increased by 10%; penetration increased by 5%]
"The art of archery is perfected."
Seeing the level of archery that had indeed been broken through with this arrow, Li Chengfeng had a look in his eyes.
He looked down at the loose laminated arch in his hand again, shook his head, took off its string, and placed it in the corner of the house.
This laminated bamboo bow is also a hero, and he plans to keep it well.
After placing the laminated bamboo bow and looking up at the room where only the last two pieces of bacon were left, Li Chengfeng knew in his heart that it was time to go hunting in the mountains.
He looked down at his increasingly muscular body, clenched his fists, and felt the strength coming from his arms, with a glint in his eyes.
I looked at the progress of Tai Chi again.
[Skill: Tai Chi]
[Level: Entry (676800)]
[Effect: Strengthening]
"Although there is no breakthrough, I have gained more than 600 proficiency points this month. Under the effect of the skills, my body has also been tempered to be much stronger than a month ago."
Li Chengfeng touched his much stronger muscles and stronger strength, and was satisfied with the gains of this month.
But then I thought of Liu Yong again, and his eyes flashedWith a cold look, "It's time to settle the matter with you."
